title: DMC: Detroit Metal City
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Soichi Negishi, a timid young man from the countryside who loves gentle pop music, is secretly Krauser II, face-painted frontman of the wildly popular death-metal band Detroit Metal City. The comedy comes from the gap between his sweet private self and the crude, violent stage persona fans adore, which he hides from Yuri Aikawa, a girl he likes.
life_message: A good life would be living as your gentle true self, though the story keeps showing how hard it is to escape a persona that pays.

content.note: Comedic violence and wild stage antics (MangaUpdates comedic violence, violence); rumors that Krauser killed his parents are a joke (ANN).
Crude sexual jokes: stage lines threaten sexual assault and Krauser is rumored a serial rapist, all as satire (ANN); MangaUpdates tags blue humor and nudity. Non-graphic in summaries.
ANN notes the f-word used 'over and over and over again'; MangaUpdates lists Mature genre and black humor.
Split identity is comedic (MangaUpdates split personality, two-faced).
Profanity, shock lyrics and violent stage antics are the main gag; ANN warns 'the humorless are likely to be easily offended'; MangaUpdates violent male lead.
Satire of the music business and fan hype (MangaUpdates music business).

folkways.japan: Soichi's rural roots and the polite gap between public face (tatemae) and true feelings (honne) are Japanese norms the comedy plays on.

delivery.evidence: ANN calls it a 'send up of performative masculinity' delivered through satire and humor, with no lecturing.

personified.ideology: shock-value transgression sold as an image

delivery.note: The comedy mocks both the vulgar persona and Soichi's timidity, leaving readers to draw the point.

winners_losers: Krauser's persona keeps winning fame while Soichi's gentle dreams keep losing; satire places sympathy with Soichi but shows the market rewarding vulgarity.
